laws.rule: Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: the by-laws prohibit consuming, storing, brewing or selling alcoholic drinks, subject to the by-law provisions on designated areas and permission (sections 11 and 13).

Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: fires are limited to facilities provided by the council, and camping is prohibited, subject to the by-law provisions on designated areas and permission (sections 11 and 13).
Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: bathing, wading or swimming in a water body is prohibited, subject to designated areas and permission under the by-law (sections 11 and 13).
Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: sound equipment is prohibited under the by-law unless an applicable designated-area or permission exception applies (sections 11 and 13).
Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: do not damage vegetation, disturb wildlife or bird nests, subject to the designated-area and permission provisions (sections 11 and 16).
Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: dogs must be on a leash and under control unless in a designated free-running area; observe dog-free signs and pick up dog waste (section 16).

Johannesburg council-managed public open spaces: vehicle speed is limited to 5 km/h, and parking is limited to designated or otherwise permitted areas, subject to designated-area and permission exceptions (sections 11 and 15).
